MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #20
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x

3. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 10

4. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 2/2
   C. 1/4
   D. They are equal

5. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 82
   C. 81
   D. 18

6. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

7. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 7
   D. 49

8. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 12.5

9. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 38
   C. 19
   D. 88

10. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 31
   C. 25
   D. 27

11. Solve for x: x + 6 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 6
   C. 15
   D. 9

12. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 29
   C. 23.6
   D. 23

13. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 1
   C. 9
   D. 20

14. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 42

15. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 144

16. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 26
   C. 10
   D. 25

17. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 15
   C. 1
   D. 56

18. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27
   C. 27.7
   D. 27.6

19. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19.7
   C. 25
   D. 19

20. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 90
   C. 36
   D. 18

21. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 0.25
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.025

22. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 32
   C. 4
   D. 12

23. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

24. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 31
   D. 1

25. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 170

26. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 12
   C. 32
   D. 4

27. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 46
   C. 120
   D. 30

28. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 17
   C. 1
   D. 73

29. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 100 m²

30. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15
   C. 15.7
   D. 15.6
